core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; OTC Healthcare; Retail Pharmacy; Generics; Veterinary Products
specialty_focus: Farmacias Similares is a major Mexican pharmacy chain that provides low-cost generic pharmaceuticals and adjacent medical consultations under the famous slogan "Lo mismo pero más barato" ("The same, but cheaper"). It targets budget-conscious consumers to make basic healthcare universally accessible. Loco Gringo Product Categories Interchangeable Generics: Affordable equivalents to brand-name prescription drugs sharing the same active ingredients.
